description: Use this when the user wants ChatGPT to use another of their Tenda workspaces, or to show tenders from another country or stop: set "workspace" to the workspace's name, or a country's key from get_tenda_settings (such as "us") to true or false. The workspace's home country stays on. Owners and admins change countries. Needs a Tenda account.
name: update_tenda_settings
title: Change Tenda settings
